messages:
sarah_sales: Heads-up — Bayview just sent over a SIG/CAIQ for the POC. They need answers + evidence within the week. Link to questionnaire: https://files.example.com/bayview-sig-2025.pdf :paperclip:

matt_security: @sarah_sales can you paste the critical asks? Is BYOK requested? :eyes:

juan_se: also need to know POC infra (GPUs, perf targets). If they want low latency we should plan for dedicated capacity.

sarah_sales: Main asks: BYOK/KMS support, data residency (US-only), SOC2 evidence for infra, and network diagram + allowed IPs. POC target date: kickoff Wed next week.

matt_security: ok i'll triage. Claiming this one. Will start mapping answers and check CC evidence we can share.

ops_bot: Created ticket SEC-4821 for Bayview SIG intake (assignee: matt_security) — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-4821

matt_security: Quick Q for @juan_se — do we expect to offer dedicated GPU during POC or will hosted suffice? Need throughput expectations to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted.

juan_se: Hosted should be fine for eval traffic (≤100 rps) but if they plan concurrency tests >400 rps we should propose Dedicated. Also requires model pinning for repeatability — note for the FAQ.

emma_cs: I have the Bayview contact (poc@bayview.com). I can ask for KMS vendor info and if they need HSM-level attestations. Do you want me to kick that off?

matt_security: yes please @emma_cs — request the KMS provider, desired key lifecycle policy, and whether they require BYOK import or remote key wrap. That will unblock most answers.

sarah_sales: FYI Bayview is asking about pricing delta for Dedicated during POC. I'll loop Finance if we need an estimate.

matt_security: Plan: I will draft the SIG responses and attach SOC2 excerpts we can share. ETA 3 business days for initial draft. Blocking: KMS details from customer and a network diagram.

emma_cs: ping to Bayview sent asking for KMS vendor + network diagram. will update ticket when they reply. :email:

matt_security: marking status: In progress — SEC-4821 assigned to matt_security. Next update once we have KMS vendor or customer reply. :thumbsup:
